title: ARahim3/DigUp
why_read: A practical, fully on-device semantic search tool across local files using Google DeepMind's small EmbeddingGemma model, appealing for privacy-conscious users wanting Spotlight-like search with actual content understanding.
analysis: DigUp lets you search your own computer's files, photos, PDFs, recordings, and code by meaning rather than exact filename, using an embedding model that runs entirely locally without sending data to the cloud. Built on Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2, a lightweight embedding model, it supports Mac, Windows, and Linux. This is a nice demonstration of how small, efficient embedding models now make semantic search viable without cloud infrastructure, which is a meaningful practical shift for privacy and cost reasons.
